Genesis10 is hiring participants for its Dev10 Software Developer cohort, which combines three to four months of paid technical training with two years of client project experience. Participants develop software skills through instruction and mentorship, then apply them on client projects and may relocate according to assignment needs.
Computer Software
No H1B
Responsibilities
Participate fully in the three-to-four-month training program and build practical skills across the technologies included in the curriculum
Apply instruction and feedback to develop your programming knowledge and problem-solving abilities
Work with peers, instructors, and Senior Engineers in a hands-on learning environment, contributing to collaborative activities and communicating ideas clearly
After training, bring your developing skills to client projects, continue learning through practical experience, and adapt to project requirements and professional team environments
Be open to relocation based on client project needs and engage with your Dev10 Manager for guidance as you navigate workplace culture and career growth
Qualification
Programming
Required
Candidates must hold a bachelor's degree
demonstrate at least six months of programming experience on their resume
Experience may come from academic coursework, personal projects, or professional work, but you must have programmed within the last three months
your resume must clearly show at least one of the following: a recent degree in a STEM field, such as Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline; or at least 12 months of professional experience in finance, healthcare, banking, insurance, hospitality, aviation, or technology, with no more than a 12-month gap since you last held that role
Genesis10 cannot provide or support employment visa or work authorization paperwork, including OPT, CPT, EAD, H-1B, or TN. Exceptions apply only to asylees, refugees, and individuals with Temporary Protected Status (TPS)
We also value a strong interest in software development, sound logic and reasoning, clear communication, collaboration, and a team-oriented approach
Benefits
Instruction and mentorship from experienced Senior Engineers
$2,500 in relocation assistance
Two years of client project experience
Support from a Dev10 Manager
Health, vision, and dental coverage
A 401(k)
Paid time off
